text:
carmen: Heads-up: onboarding venice13b-v2 (quant int4) we hit a surprising QA regression vs venice13b-v1 in the summarization suite. Not OOM-related but quality drop at long summaries. quick A/B notes below.

carmen: Evaluation run: summarization-eval-2026-03-20: 1000 prompts, avg ROUGE-L v1=37.2, v2=34.1 (delta -3.1). human spot-check shows more repetition and occasional hallucinated facts.

evam: hmm are we seeing tokenization shift? v2 pipeline uses fused kernel + different sampling seed handling in our runtime. also quantization per-layer scale math changed slightly in the quantizer.

lina: we saw a small shift in logits around rare tokens during quantization experiments. could account for hallucinations. did you run full eval at multiple temperatures?

carmen: ran temp=0.7 and 0.9, both show drop. perplexity on eval set increased ~4%.

ops-bot: Note: no OOMs in this run. separate thread for memory.

evam: action: (1) run matrix with kernel=legacy vs fused, quantized rounding mode=nearest vs stochastic, and per-layer clip thresholds. (2) run per-layer activation histograms to debug scale mismatch.

carmen: started matrix. early signal: legacy kernel with stochastic rounding recovers ~1.5 points of ROUGE-L. switching rounding to nearest under fused loses an extra 0.7. per-layer activations show a shift in layer 23-25.

lina: maybe our per-channel scaling for that block got slightly under-calibrated during k-means clip. try recalibrating block 23-25 with higher calibration samples.

carmen: will run targeted recalibration and then re-eval. note: the memory mitigations we applied (reduce max_new_tokens) may also change generation dynamics in dataset; keep config consistent when comparing.

(2 hours later)

carmen: recalibrated layers 23-25 with 50k calibration tokens. re-run: v2 now ROUGE-L=35.6 (delta -1.6). still not fully recovered but much better.

elvan: promising. we should include per-layer calibration step in onboarding pipeline for int4 models and add a QA gate threshold.

lina: agreed. also add sampling-seed parity test between v1 and v2 to ensure runtime determinism isn't shifting outputs.

carmen: opening PR to include layer-targeted recalibration and QA gate: https://git.redwood/models/patches/9001. adding note to onboarding checklist: "Run per-layer activations histogram and targeted recalibration for layers with >1.5% mean shift."

ops-bot: PR CI: green. Onboarding gate: manual QA required for v2 vs v1 ROUGE delta < 2.0.

carmen: scheduling a small canary to run with new calibration + stochastic rounding under legacy kernel to compare. will keep thread updated.

ops-bot: Canary run queued.

carmen: quick update: canary with calibration + stochastic rounding + legacy kernel at 5% traffic -> ROUGE-L=36.9 (delta -0.3). rolling to 20% after 30m smoke.

lina: note to docs: quant calibration matters more for middle transformer blocks on venice13b family. add to per-model tuning doc.

carmen: thanks all. will keep monitoring quality metrics.
